{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Eros|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Eros''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Silk Touch]]. It is crafted from a [[Shakudo Alloy]], four arrows and three [[Estus Ash]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/silk_touch.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Eros" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Eros is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Silk Touch applies to mining tools. It is exclusive with [[Fortune]] and with the electrum and adamant tool [[intrinsic]]s. [[Shakudo equipment|Shakudo]] tools already have Silk Touch as an intrinsic.

== Trivia ==
* Eros is the Greek god of love, who strikes with arrows; the "soft touch" of love matches Silk Touch. The pack also has an advancement called "Wings of Eros".
